Respondent
 ......
 Mr. Aniket U. Nikam i/b. Mr. V.N. Arote for the Applicant.
 Mr. Ameet Palkar, App for the Respondent-State.
 ......
 Coram: V.G.Bisht, J.
 Date: 4Th December, 2021
 Pc:-

1. Heard learned Counsel for the applicant and learned  APP.
 2. Perused the First Information Report (FIR).
 3.
It appears that the applicant was found storing Gutkha  and Paan Masala in his premises.
However, having regard to  the facts and circumstances of the case, prima facie the  applicability of Section 328 of the IPC appears to be doubtful.
The applicant, therefore, has made out a case for ad-interim  protection.

Hence the following order is passed :
 ORDER (i) In the event of arrest of the applicant in C.R.No. 770 of 2021 registered with Shirur Police 18-ABA-2866-2021.DOC Station, Pune Rural for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188,
272, 273 read with 34 of the IPC and Sections 26 (2) (i), 26 (2) (ii), 26 (2)
Bapu Subhash Borhade vs The State Of Maharashtra on 4 December, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150391976/
1 (iv), 27 (3) (d), 30 (2) (a) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant be enlarged on bail on his furnishing PR & SB in the sum of Rs. 20,000/- with one or two surety/sureties in like amount.
